description: This Java source file defines the 'Details' class, an Android Activity that displays data details in a scrollable view. It supports viewing, requerying data from a content provider, and printing data to stdout.

classes.name: Details
classes.description: An Android Activity class that displays detailed data passed via intent, with options to requery and print data.

methods.description: Initializes activity, sets title, and populates data views.

methods.description: Handles resume event; currently just calls superclass implementation.

methods.description: Creates options menu with 'Requery' and 'Print to stdout' actions.

methods.description: Builds the UI to display data items.
